disclaimer.title: How reviews work
disclaimer.subtitle: Reviews from past guests help our community learn more about each home. By default, reviews are sorted by relevance. Relevance is based on recency, length and information that you provide to us, such as your booking search, your country and your language preferences. Only the guest who made the reservation can leave a review, and Airbnb only moderates reviews flagged for not following our policies. To be eligible for a percentile ranking or guest favourite label, listings need at least 5 reviews in the last 4 years. Criteria are subject to change. Learn more in our Help Centre
